content.text:
I submitted index 28 (Sb 0.835, Zn 0.165) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, but that value is only 0.0044%, and three measurements can't show that it's the best in the library.

I used all 3 EQE measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 28 | 0.835 | 0.0044 |
| 10 | 0.491 | 0.0009 |
| 21 | 0.784 | −0.0014 (no photoresponse) |

**XRD:** I used 3 of the 5 XRD scans, on indices 4, 16 and 28. All three show the same basic crystal pattern. The Sb-rich films (16 and 28) have two extra peaks, at about Q = 2.44 and 3.63 Å⁻¹, which suggest a second phase. I did not identify which phase that is.

**Main uncertainty:** 19 of the 29 compositions were never measured. The model's top suggestion for the last measurement was index 18. I measured index 21 instead because the two readings so far favoured the Sb-rich end, and it came back negative. So I can't rule out a better composition somewhere else on the line. With EQE values this small and one measurement below zero, the gaps between readings may be partly noise.
